content:
Apple today released a new version of its Apple Invites app for iPhone. The update takes advantage of new features in iOS 27, including improved photo sharing and the Image Playground feature.

Below are the full release notes for the Apple Invites update Apple released today:

  • Shared Albums now support full-resolution sharing, allowing you to relive every moment in stunning detail within the app. Anyone can join and contribute photos, even those without an Apple device.
  • Image Playground can now create high-quality backgrounds in nearly any style, including photorealistic, so your invitations can perfectly capture the mood you want.
  • Guests who need to verify their email can now tap a link in their inbox instead of entering a verification code, making it easier to attend an event.
  • This update includes bug fixes and performance improvements.

You can download Apple Invites from the App Store. Creating an invitation requires an iCloud+ subscription, but anyone can RSVP.
